_meta.description: Mi Speaks reads articles, books and PDFs aloud in twenty-eight neural Studio Voices generated entirely on your iPhone. Offline, private, and the spoken word highlighted on the page it came from.
_title: Mi Speaks — Neural voices that read anything aloud, on your iPhone
a-voice-you-will.2a89c7: A voice you will actually want to listen to
absolutely-mi-speaks-works.647c20: Absolutely! Mi Speaks works with any voice installed on your device. You can download additional voices in your device's Settings app to access different languages, accents, and voice styles.
affordable-private-text-to.36ac6d: Affordable, private text-to-speech that runs entirely on your device
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
built-in-helpful-tips.a104d6: Built-in helpful tips guide you through features and help you get the most out of Mi Speaks.
can-i-import-text.83b6aa: Can I import text from images?
complete-privacy-all-processing.b37baf: Complete privacy—all processing happens on your device. No data is collected, tracked, or sent anywhere. Affordable and privacy-focused.
does-it-highlight-text.8717e1: Does it highlight text as it reads?
download-free-then-try.21f9b8: Download free, then try Premium free for 7 days
every-clip-on-this.f51d66: Every clip on this page was generated on-device by the same engine that ships in the app. Studio Voices are part of Premium and need a one-time download.
every-voice-runs-locally.1555ee: Every voice runs locally. Your text is never uploaded, never sent to a server to be spoken, and never needs an account — which also means Mi Speaks works the same in airplane mode as it does on Wi-Fi.
five-of-them-same.82d47a: Five of them, same passage, straight off a phone. Press play.
follow-along-with-highlighted.2309b6: Follow along with highlighted text as Mi Speaks reads, making it easier to read and comprehend content.
free-is-a-real.33ccd1: Free is a real app, not a demo
import-a-pdf-and.05fcc5: Import a PDF and read it where it actually lives: the real page, the real layout, with the spoken word lit up exactly where it sits. Turn it off and you are back to plain sentences — it is a mode, not a takeover.
iphone-ipad-and-apple.038fee: iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch — the same library, the same place in it
is-mi-speaks-available.cc6f02: Is Mi Speaks available in the European Union?
keep-listening-in-another.a95c5b: Keep listening in another app or with the screen locked, with play, pause and skip on the lock screen. If a Studio Voice passage isn't prepared yet, it carries on in your own system voice — the reading never just stops.
mi-speaks-can-read.079199: Mi Speaks can read any written content including text you type, content from other apps, text extracted from images, and PDF files. Perfect for articles, documents, emails, books, and more.
mi-speaks-reads-a.209fd0: Mi Speaks reads a PDF's own table of contents, and when a book has none it finds the headings from the page layout. A four-hundred-page import becomes a list you can move around in — and the skip buttons on your lock screen move chapter by chapter.
mi-speaks-reads-articles.2bbb34: Mi Speaks reads articles, books and PDFs aloud in twenty-eight neural Studio Voices — generated entirely on your iPhone. No account, no upload, no signal. Follow along word by word, right on the page it came from.
neural-studio-voices-imported.d06009: Neural Studio Voices, imported books on their own page, chapter navigation, and audio prepared before you need it
no-every-voice-system.4a3674: No. Every voice, system and Studio alike, runs on your device, and Mi Speaks has no account to sign in to. If you turn on Premium's library sync, your saved speeches travel through your own iCloud Drive — Apple's, not mine. I never see them.
perfect-for-reading-articles.f2b09e: Perfect for reading articles while commuting, listening to documents while working out, or helping with accessibility needs.
premium-adds-the-twenty.c581e1: Premium adds the twenty-eight Studio Voices, an unlimited library synced across your devices, audio export, and Turbo playback speeds. Monthly, yearly, or bought once and kept.
premium-adds-the-twenty.ec35ec: Premium adds the twenty-eight neural Studio Voices, an unlimited library of saved speeches synced across your devices via iCloud Drive, audio export to a file, and Turbo playback speeds. It is sold monthly, yearly, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Free is not time-limited and has no length limit: any text, any system voice, three saved speeches.
prepare-a-whole-document.ec2ba7: Prepare a whole document once and every sentence is already rendered to audio. It keeps playing with the screen locked, in a tunnel, on a plane. Your place follows you to your iPad and Apple Watch, and prepared documents are sent to the watch on their own — so it reads them in the same Studio Voice.
ready-for-ios-27.75e4d6: ✓ Ready for iOS 27 / iPadOS 27 / watchOS 27
share-a-pdf-from.e98080: Share a PDF from Files, Safari or Mail and it opens as the real document, with its pages, highlighting and chapters. Paste text from any app, or photograph a page and Mi Speaks reads the words off it.
studio-voices-are-neural.3f3a44: Studio Voices are neural voices: instead of stitching together recorded fragments, an eighty-two-million-parameter model generates the waveform from the text, which is why the phrasing and breath sound human. The model and its voice packs are about 325 MB, downloaded once over Wi-Fi and then kept on the device. Nothing is sent anywhere afterwards — or during, beyond fetching the files themselves.
studio-voices-or-any.a03d7c: Studio Voices, or any voice you own
there-is-no-length.989103: There is no length limit on the free tier. Paste a whole article, import a whole book, and listen to all of it with any voice on your device — no trial countdown, no truncation, no paywall in the middle of a chapter. Free keeps three saved speeches, each with its own place marked.
there-is-one-real.bf3cef: There is one real limit, and it is not the network: generating a neural voice uses the graphics processor, and iOS will not run that while an app is off screen. Tap Prepare Full Document and every sentence is rendered up front, so the Studio Voice reads to the end with the screen locked, in another app, or on a flight. Skip that step and nothing stops: any passage that isn't ready yet is read in your own system voice, and Mi Speaks offers to prepare the document for next time.
transform-any-written-content.0d5682: Transform any written content into natural-sounding speech. Import text from images, PDFs, web pages, or type directly into the app. Mi Speaks makes all your content accessible through audio.
twenty-eight-neural-studio.78d344: Twenty-eight neural Studio Voices, plus every system voice already on your device — including Apple's Enhanced and Premium downloads and your own Personal Voice. Mi Speaks tells you which is which, so you are never handed the worst one by default.
twenty-eight-neural-voices.899e23: Twenty-eight neural voices, American and British, produced on your iPhone by an eighty-two-million-parameter model. They breathe, they phrase, and they stop sounding like a phone reading to you. Part of Premium, with a one-time download.
twenty-eight-neural-voices.eb2f6a: Twenty-eight neural voices, generated entirely on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded, and they work in airplane mode.
what-are-studio-voices.a8efa6: What are Studio Voices, and why is there a download?
what-can-i-listen.482923: What can I listen to with Mi Speaks?
yes-completely-every-voice.c29d4e: Yes, completely. Every voice runs on the device — the system voices are already there, and the Studio Voices are a one-time download you keep. Nothing needs a connection after that. The one thing worth knowing is that generating a neural voice needs the graphics processor, which iOS only allows while the app is on screen — so Prepare Full Document renders everything up front, and then a long read plays to the end however you put your phone away.
yes-mi-speaks-highlights.298462: Yes! Mi Speaks highlights and follows spoken words as it reads, making it easier to follow along, improve comprehension, and learn new content.
yes-mi-speaks-includes.7a0f2a: Yes! Mi Speaks includes powerful text recognition that can extract text from images and PDF files, making it easy to listen to content from photos, documents, and scanned materials.
yes-mi-speaks-is.888a80: Yes. Mi Speaks is on the App Store everywhere in the European Union, France included. It's available in every App Store territory Apple offers.
your-book-on-its.3a3c23: Your book, on its own page
